correctness.rationale: For x^prime=-a x - b x(t-tau)-c x(t-2tau), with b≠0,c>0,c<a<3c,b²=8c(a-c), frequency elimination has the unique double positive z=(a-c)(3c-a)=omega². Phase equations determine only tau_n=(theta+2πn)/omega. The identities b*exp(-i theta)+2c exp(-2i theta)=-2c and f_lambda=1+2c*tau_n>0 show a simple imaginary pair. Implicit differentiation gives Re lambda^prime(tau_n)=0 and Re lambda^doubleprime=2omega²(a-3c)/(1+2c tau_n)^3<0, proving left-side quadratic contact. At tau->0 all RHP roots would be uniformly bounded by |lambda+a|<=|b|+c and tend to -a-b-c<0, contradiction; roots cannot enter RHP from infinity at finite tau. With no other imaginary frequencies and no crossovers, zero RHP count persists for all tau>0. Independent exact SymPy checked the derivative and three sample parameter sets; analytic proof establishes the continuum result.
residual_risks: The conclusion concerns linear asymptotic stability, not nonlinear Hopf; does not classify other discriminant regions.
